recipes.title: Beef Brisket Dice
steps: Soak beef in salt + water for 10 min.
Fry to cook beef with oil.
In a new pot, add beef and all seasoning.
Cover with water for 40 min on low heat (or use Instant Pot, then reduce after).
Add carrot and potato, cover 20 min. Finish.

recipes.title: Beef Brisket Tendon Pot
steps: Fry ginger.
Fry brisket and tendon.
Add sauce: dark soy, light soy, chu hou sauce, cooking wine, fermented tofu, and satay sauce.
Add star anise, rock sugar, and bay leaves later; add salt later. Simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Korean Short Rib
steps: Soak rib 1 hr (up to 4 hr).
Blend 3/4 of the soy, rice wine, water, sugar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, and pepper to make the sauce.
Drain rib and trim fat.
Instant Pot 35 min on high with veggies and sauce.
Natural decompress. Transfer meat and veggies out; reduce and add the rest of the sauce.
Mix sauce in after.

recipes.title: Pot Roast with Red Wine
ingredients: 1 cup red wine or chicken stock
1/4 cup flour (only if you need to thicken)
steps: Instant Pot sauté with oil; sear bacon 4 min, then drain on paper towel.
Add beef to pot, sear 3-4 min.
Add red wine, reduce 5 min; add beef broth, tomato paste, and bouillon.
Stir; add bacon, carrot, onion, garlic, thyme, potato, mushroom, salt & pepper. Pressure cook / manual 45 min.
Natural release 10 min, switch to vent, then set to sauté to thicken 5-10 min.
Stir and add salt & pepper if needed.
Note: use large chunks (not pre-cut), use large carrots, and sear on the pan with salt & pepper.

recipes.title: Skirt Steak with wasabi fish sauce
steps: Season steak with Mesquite spice and lemon juice, 5-10 min.
Grill on a cast iron pan. Don't overcook; use palm-tenderness to check and compare.
Make sauce: 2 part soy sauce, 1 part fish sauce, mix in wasabi.
Remove and rest 8-10 min. Slice against the grain, as thin as possible.
Sauce on top or use as dip.

recipes.title: Viet Tomato finger rib
steps: Cut onions and carrot.
Smack the lemongrass.
In a pan, sear the finger rib on all sides.
Remove the finger rib.
Sear ginger, lemongrass, and onion; cook till soft on medium heat.
Cook star anise with the onion.
Add both cans of tomato paste, mix.
Change from pan to pot.
Add the canned tomato; add some water if needed (should be somewhat sticky).
Add beef.
Add bay leaves.
Add carrot and rock sugar.
Small flame, 1 hr.
Add 3 tablespoon fish sauce.
Add pepper.
Note: about 30 min to cook, then another hr.
